criteria.criterion: Use only the exact-card Scryfall API response at the provided URL
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent relied exclusively on the JSON returned by the exact-card endpoint (https://api.scryfall.com/cards/named?exact=Black%20Lotus) and did not use other sources, other Scryfall endpoints, or inferred/guessed values. Full credit if all reported fields are clearly attributable to that single response OR if the agent attempts to access the URL and clearly reports an access/blocker (e.g., network error, rate limit, downtime) or that the endpoint returned an error object that prevents extraction. Partial credit if the agent appears to use the right card but also mixes in external knowledge or other endpoints. No credit if the agent uses a different card response or clearly fabricates fields while claiming they came from the URL.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints (no pricing/links; stop after requested fields)

Full credit if the agent reports only the requested fields (or, if blocked, reports the blocker and stops) and avoids price/purchase-link content. Partial credit if extra unrelated fields are included but constraints are otherwise respected. No credit if pricing fields/purchase links are used or emphasized contrary to constraints, or if the agent continues beyond what is needed.
